title: Fix Procedural Plugin Clippy Failures
description: Fix pre-existing clippy warnings (clippy::map_unwrap_or and unused_qualifications) in the procedural plugin crate semio-s-plugin-procedural.
summary: Fixed pre-existing clippy violations in semio-s-plugin-procedural. Replaced map().unwrap_or() calls with map_or() in updateGenerationValues command handlers in both 2d and 3d component.rs files. Removed redundant crate::artifacts::procedural3d::engine qualification in test_support::lock() call in 3d component.rs. Verified cargo check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings (0 warnings/errors for semio-s-plugin-procedural), and cargo test (196/196 tests passing clean). Removed temporary workspace overlay and build artifacts.
